description_zh: 调用DescribeJobHistory接口查询任务记录
name: DescribeJobHistory

parameters.help_en: The ID of the job template
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 0 to 10000
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页数量。取值范围[0,10000]
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The status of the job. Valid values:

0: The job is not executed.

1: The job is executed.

2: The job fails to be executed.

3: The job is being executed
parameters.help_zh:
任务的运行状态。取值说明如下：
0：未执行。
1：执行成功。
2：执行失败。
3：正在执行
parameters.name: state

Code.description_en:
The HTTP status code returned. Valid values:

2xx: The call was successful.

3xx: The call was redirected.

4xx: The call failed.

5xx: A server error occurred
Code.description_zh:
接口状态或POP错误码。取值说明如下：

2xx：成功。
3xx：重定向。
4xx：请求错误。
5xx：服务器错误

CurrentPage.description_en: The page number of the returned page

CompletionTime.description_en: The time when the job was executed

Failed.description_en: The number of instances that failed to run

Message.description_en: The message returned if exceptions occur during job running
Message.description_zh: 任务执行异常时的附加信息

StartTime.description_en: The time when the job was created

State.description_en:
The status of the job. Valid values:

0: The job was not executed.

1: The job was executed.

2: The job failed to be executed.

3: The job is being executed
State.description_zh:
任务的运行状态。取值说明如下：
0：未执行。
1：执行成功。
2：执行失败。
3：正在执行

Succeeded.description_en: The number of instances that are successfully run

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 0 to 10000
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页数量。取值范围[0,10000]

ErrorCode.description_en:
The error code returned. Take note of the following rules:

If the call is successful, the ErrorCode parameter is not returned.

If the call fails, the ErrorCode parameter is returned. For more information, see the "Error codes" section in this topic
ErrorCode.description_zh:
错误码。取值说明如下：

请求成功：不返回ErrorCode字段。
请求失败：返回ErrorCode字段。具体信息，请参见本文的错误码目录

Message.description_en:
The message returned. Take note of the following rules:

If the call is successful, success is returned.

If the call fails, an error code is returned
Message.description_zh:
附加信息。取值说明如下：

请求正常，返回success。
请求异常，返回具体异常错误码

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:

true

false
Success.description_zh:
查询任务状态是否成功。取值说明如下：

true：查询成功。
false：查询失败

TraceId.description_en: The trace ID that is used to query the details of the request
TraceId.description_zh: 调用链ID，用于精确查询调用信息
